verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents public client-library APIs in multiple languages (C++ and Python) that expose its core functionality: topics, services, actions and parameters. It also documents a scriptable `ros2` CLI (e.g. `ros2 topic pub`) and a Python API for reading and writing bags. Together these let a programmatic or AI-driven user operate the system end to end, and a community user notes LLMs handle ROS boilerplate well. missing for 10: API parity across languages (lifecycle, composition, intra-process and content filtering are C++-only), API reference-level documentation in the evidence beyond concept pages, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
